messages:
dahlia: Post-deploy quickcheck for v2.14.0 finished. overall looks green except apac2 on the embeddings route. dropping this thread for coordination.

deploy-bot: postdeploy-checker: release=v2.14.0
apac2 /route=embeddings -> synthetic-failure: FAILED
metric: 5xx_rate 0.6% -> 2.8% (10m)
p95 latency 120ms -> 520ms
sample log:
```
[2026-04-02T03:12:08Z] ERR 502 model-serve timeout seq=512 host=apac2-i-09b3
```
action: probe_mark=FAILED, suggested_action=pin_or_rollback

samir: confirmed on grafana — spike looks correlated with the new quantized variant rolled at 03:00 UTC. error stack points to kv-cache miss + model timeout.

maya: can we pin apac2 back to embed-v1.2? that should be the stable variant. pinning keeps global rollout but overrides region. i can do it if we agree. :thumbsup:

leo: quick question — pin vs full rollback? pin is less blast radius but might hide a rollout bug that affects other regions later.

dahlia: prefer pin on apac2 for now to restore customer traffic quickly. if other regions trend up we'll rollback globally.

maya: command i'll run: `redwoodctl rollout set --region apac2 --model embed-v1.2 --pin --reason "postdeploy quickcheck: apac2 5xx spike"`

ops-oncall: on it, running the pin now. i'll post status and keep the probe sampling on high frequency for 15m.

deploy-bot: rollout-api: accepted request by maya -> job_id=rb-3777-apac2-pin-01. applying config.

ops-oncall: pin applied. job_id rb-3777-apac2-pin-01 -> SUCCESS (2026-04-02T03:24:11Z). initial traffic shift completed, directing 95% to embed-v1.2, 5% to v1.3 for canary.

samir: seeing immediate drop in 5xx to 0.7% and p95 back to ~140ms. nice.

leo: leaving synthetic probes on for next 1h and telemetry alerts at a lower threshold. if 5xx creeps above 1.0% we escalate.

dahlia: action items: 1) add an entry in release notes: "apac2 pin to embed-v1.2 due to postdeploy latency/5xx spike" 2) create a follow-up ticket to root cause the kv-cache interactions with quantized variant 3) hold any further model variant rollouts for 24h.

maya: added release note draft to the release PR and created ticket RN-4821 (root cause) and SLA-ops-239 for monitoring tweak.

ops-oncall: started a 1h watch. will update at +15m and +60m.

leo: ping me if it reappears, i'll prepare a global rollback playbook just in case.

dahlia: thanks team. marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if probe flaps again. :white_check_mark:
